items.front: What causes acid rain vs photochemical smog?
items.back: Acid rain = SO₂ + NOx; smog = NOx + VOC + sunlight → O₃, PAN.
items.examPoint: Acid rain (SO2 + NOx) & photochemical smog (NOx+VOC+UV→PAN, O3)

items.front: BPA is a component of which plastic?
items.back: Polycarbonate; it is an endocrine disruptor.

items.front: Which are decomposers: virus, fungi, bacteria?
items.back: Fungi and bacteria (viruses are NOT decomposers).

items.front: Sea cow, sea horse, sea lion — mammals?
items.back: Sea cow & sea lion = mammals; sea horse = fish.
items.examPoint: Classification — mammals vs fish (sea cow, sea lion vs sea horse)
